items.name: wheel of cheese
items.description: A perfectly ordinary wheel of cheese. Somewhere, a goblin is keeping a tally of how many you've taken.

items.name: well-polished mug
items.description: The barkeep has been polishing this for years. It is the cleanest object in the county, and he will notice it's gone.

items.name: rusty short sword
items.description: More rust than sword. It was a good sword once, much like most of us were once good at things.

items.name: ring of suspicious keys
items.description: None of them fit anything. All of them are definitely important.

items.name: scroll of Frost Lance
items.description: A water-stained scroll. The ink is cold to the touch.

items.name: leather cap
items.description: Smells of the previous owner's worries.

items.name: padded jerkin
items.description: Quilted, lumpy, and surprisingly effective against rats.

items.name: wooden shield
items.description: A round shield with a face painted on it. The face looks worried.

items.name: iron sword
items.description: Honest iron. Slightly better than being punched.

items.name: oak staff
items.description: A walking stick with ambitions.

items.name: healing draught
items.description: A small bottle of something green. It tastes of mint and regret.

items.name: loaf of travel bread
items.description: Dense, dry, and loyal. It will outlive you.

items.name: dried sausage
items.description: Nobody asks what's in it. Everybody asks for another.

items.name: mug of ale
items.description: Filling, in the way a handshake is filling.

items.name: loot goblin's ledger
items.description: Eleven years of meticulous entries. Your name appears on every page, and not kindly.

items.name: bone-hilted dagger
items.description: Light, balanced, and made from something you'd rather not identify.

items.name: tattered gloves
items.description: Fingerless by accident.

items.name: barrel-stave club
items.description: A stave from a barrel that was 'allegedly' a barrel. It still seems a little smug.

items.name: lantern shard
items.description: A sliver of pale glass that gives off a cold, steady light. Worth a lot to the right collector.

items.name: wraith-silk boots
items.description: They make no sound. Neither do you, now. You didn't ask for this.

items.name: guild pamphlet
items.description: 'CASUAL-FRIENDLY, HARDCORE-PROGRESSION.' The paper is excellent for lighting fires.

items.name: dire chicken feather
items.description: Surprisingly soft. Slightly accusing.

items.name: Blade of Indisputable Authority
items.description: It has never lost an argument. It does not argue; it simply concludes. Only the architects of this place can lift it.

items.name: unusually shiny pebble
items.description: It's just a pebble. A very well-polished pebble.

items.name: lucky rabbit's foot
items.description: Lucky for someone. Not the rabbit.

items.name: dented flask
items.description: Something in it hums. Smells of ozone and bad decisions. Probably safe.

items.name: bag of ordinary beans
items.description: They're beans. Ozzie says they're magic. Timbles says they're beans.
